newsitem.title: USA: Monarch to sell lathe business.
newsitem.headline: Monarch to sell lathe business.

text.p: Monarch Machine Tool Co said on Thursday it has agreed to sell its lathe business located in Sidney, Ohio to Monarch Lathes LP.
The buyer is a newly organized partnership, of which Lucas Precision Inc is the general partner, Monarch Machine said in a statement. The transaction is expected to close on or about July 31, 1997.
Monarch said the sale should generate $12 million in cash, including the retention of accounts receivable.
Monarch said Monarch Lathes will assume $500,000 in liabilities and has agreed to pay a $1.8 million royalty over five years. The assets are being sold at approximately book value.

The buyer is purchasing the inventory, machinery and equipment, and all rights to manufacture and service the Monarch lathe product line, the company said. The lathe business generated 1996 sales of $25.6 million.
Monarch Lathes is also entering into a five-year lease of the company's Sidney facility and assuming certain liabilities of the lathe business.
